_comment: Operational overlay for the Aagaard fleet. Accounts are the fleet's own (hive-fleet-operations-service); this file sets the gates, cadence, and per-account risk envelopes. 'live' is intentionally false: the platform runs, plans, and records but signs nothing until a human arms it (AAGAARD_LIVE=1 or POST /ops/arm). Locked lanes (posting, gaming) can never be enabled here.
_enabledComment: Armed for VOTING only — the trading lane is intentionally off until separately reviewed/authorized. Add "trading" here to re-enable it. (Arming itself is via AAGAARD_LIVE=1 in the deployment env, not this file, so the committed default stays dry-run.)

sigmund-vexler._comment: Sandbox: the one account sanctioned for live financial action. Its voting character (alpha-hunter over the whole trending field) is seeded in src/strategy.mts; the optional 'strategy' block below would retune which feeds it watches and how it weights them.

_strategyExample._comment: Per-account voting character override. Copy under a real account name to redirect its votes. 'feeds' chooses the slice of chain it watches (any combination); 'objective' weights how it ranks that field. Omitted fields fall back to the account's seeded character.

pacing._comment: How it spends mana: at most maxVotesPerTick per tick, only on opportunities that out-score the field's typical candidate by 'conviction', and never below votingPowerFloorBps voting power (husbanding mana). One good vote per tick, or none.
